requirement: Map a create-antibiotic command to a new Antibiotic model: copy the name, group, and classification, build exactly one standard Dosage linked to the new antibiotic with a null CrCl range, let the entity generate its ID, and report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Amoxicillin, Access classification, oral standard dose of 500 mg every 8 hours

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new Antibiotic
Name, group ID, and classification copied; a generated non-empty ID is assigned
Exactly one standard dosage is attached, with the antibiotic ID, route, and dose copied and a null CrCl

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
